responsibility: Implements timer-driven preemptive scheduling support for gm2 Processes. It creates a dedicated high-priority timer process, arms RTint time vectors, attaches timer interrupts to that process, and on each quantum expiration re-arms the timer and yields through Wait so the ready queue can rotate, thereby layering periodic preemption over the underlying coroutine/process scheduler.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the Preemptive pair: unlike Preemptive.def's lone interface declaration, it defines the timer coroutine/process, attaches and re-arms RTint time vectors, and activates periodic Wait-based rescheduling in the Processes runtime.
